name: spineboy-pro
note: Mechanical transcription of Spine's official spineboy `pro` export (the spineboy rung of docs/LADDER.md, where it is the STRETCH figure and does not count towards the rung), written to prove that a rig spec can express a foreign skeleton that carries IK and transform constraints, twelve meshes (ten weighted, two not), a clipping attachment, a bounding box and events. It is NOT an authored rig: the numbers were copied out of the reference, so it says nothing about whether an agent could produce them. Weighted meshes are transcribed into the by-name `weights` form rather than Spine's index run — the compiler resolves the names back to the same indices, so it is a lossless change of vocabulary and not a change of geometry. The example art is not redistributed here — `--images examples/spineboy/images` supplies it, and `examples/` is gitignored (see NOTICE.md).
